items.title: Capture M0 profiling baseline and runtime hot-path cost
items.context: Record current full 1M baseline and representative runtime pack timings as non-authoritative benchmark evidence. This must remain report-only and must not make memory gate evidence.
items.userSees: User runs node packages/main/dist/tasks/playbook-runtime-memory-index-smoke.js and sees a PASS line that includes current full-baseline timing and representative runtime-pack timing as report-only non-authoritative profiling evidence.

happy.desc: M0 profiling records current full-baseline and runtime-pack costs as report-only metrics without changing gate semantics.

edge.desc: Profiling output remains non-authoritative and does not set gateEvidence or lifecycle completion proof.

adversarial.desc: A failed or slow full baseline cannot be used as a normal session_brief path or as gate evidence.

items.title: Add M1 derived runtime memory index with atomic rebuild semantics
items.context: Define a disposable local index rebuilt from dev-memory/playbook source files. Rebuild must write temp, validate manifest/digest, then atomically swap indexVersion so readers never observe partial indexes.
items.userSees: User sees the index smoke print that a derived runtime memory index was rebuilt through temp-build, manifest validation, and atomic swap, with no reader observing a partial index.

happy.desc: Index rebuild creates a validated manifest and active index version from source memory and playbook files.

edge.desc: A malformed or incomplete temp index is rejected and the previous complete index remains readable.

adversarial.desc: Readers never consume a partially written index during rebuild; they see either previous complete index or new complete index.

items.title: Implement M2 indexed two-stage retrieval with small fixture parity
items.context: Runtime pack generation should retrieve indexed candidates, rank only bounded candidates, and match existing full-scan behavior on active/candidate/superseded/stale/deprecated/malformed small fixtures. Preserve gateEvidence=false and non-authoritative output.
